eras.note: Assumed decennial map preceding the current one; this project's data begins in 2016, so its earlier years are outside the checked range.

eras.label: current
eras.note: All 46 Senate seats are elected together every 4 years, coinciding with presidential-election years (2020, 2024, 2028) — not gubernatorial years, which run on their own offset 4-year cycle (2018, 2022, 2026, 2030). The new map wasn't on the 2022 ballot — 2024 was its first cycle. Same quorum-present veto-override caveat as the House.
